paper_title: BICEP / Keck XIV: Improved constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, computed from g < (4.5e-12 GeV^-1) m/(1e-21 eV) over the stated 1-30 d range
notes: CMB polarization oscillation search (BICEP/Keck XIV). Limit constrains axion-photon coupling assuming axions are all of DM (kappa=1) at rho0=0.3 GeV/cm^3. Reported relation g_phigamma < (4.5e-12 GeV^-1) * m/(1e-21 eV) valid for 1.6e-21 <= m <= 4.8e-20 eV (1-30 d periods). Two endpoints computed accordingly. A smoothed approximation (Eq. 15) extends over the full 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV range but the clean quoted result is the 1-30 d band.
